base_image: not buildable for CPU-only scoring (see findings)
environment_contract_findings: score.py refuses to run outside METR's privileged scoring group: its __main__ calls scoring.check_scoring_group(), which we executed directly in a clean container and which raises AssertionError, re-raised by score.py as PermissionError('Must use the `score` action to register an offical score').

The scorer also builds its input with device='cuda' and reads the solution from the fixed agent path /home/agent/solution/solution.py, so it is bound to a GPU task environment rather than to a package set.
This is therefore not a dependency-or-environment failure. The gate was executed; the CUDA path was determined by code inspection, not run.
